summary: vanexa-agent bundles a WebSocket-driven remote shell backed by an author-controlled relay
details: The published bundle (dist/bundle.cjs) connects to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint at vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches messages received over that channel to child_process execution primitives (cmd.exe/powershell on Windows, /bin/bash and /bin/sh on macOS/Linux). Once the agent daemon is running on the installer's host, any party able to reach the author-controlled Cloudflare Worker can execute arbitrary commands on that host, which constitutes a persistent remote-command backdoor rather than the advertised phone-to-agent bridge. In addition, the same bundle hardcodes a fallback LLM endpoint at vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev alongside the direct OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Generative Language, DeepSeek, and Alibaba DashScope base URLs; prompts and any user-supplied provider API keys routed through this fallback traverse the author's Worker, contradicting the README's explicit BYOK / no-middleman claim.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
